# Greater Green Bay Community Foundation

> > A community foundation dedicated to strengthening the Greater Green Bay region through strategic philanthropy, grant-making, and collaborative community initiatives.

The Greater Green Bay Community Foundation serves Brown, Kewaunee, and Oconto Counties in Northeast Wisconsin, offering donor-advised funds, grant programs, scholarships, and impact investing opportunities. The foundation focuses on community needs assessment, nonprofit capacity building, and major initiatives like Give BIG Green Bay and homelessness prevention.

- [Our Approach](https://www.ggbcf.org/our-approach): Philanthropic approach and collaborative giving strategy of the Foundation
- [Community Needs](https://www.ggbcf.org/community-needs): Data-driven analysis of critical community needs in Greater Green Bay region
- [Team Members](https://www.ggbcf.org/team): Directory of staff members including Dennis Buehler, Amber Paluch, and team leadership
- [Contact Us](https://www.ggbcf.org/contact-us): Contact information, office hours, and meeting space details for the Foundation

## Ways to Give

- [Ways to Give](https://www.ggbcf.org/donors): Donor options including donor-advised funds, planned giving, and legacy giving strategies
- [For Fundholders](https://www.ggbcf.org/for-fundholders): Resources for fundholders including grant-making guides and donor dashboards
- [For Professional Advisors](https://www.ggbcf.org/professional-advisors): Resources for professional advisors on donor-advised funds and planned giving strategies
- [Impact Investing](https://www.ggbcf.org/impact-investing): Impact investing programs and Community Development Financial Institution partnerships
- [Investment Strategy](https://www.ggbcf.org/investment-strategy): Investment strategy, asset allocation, and endowment fund management policies
- [Estate Planning Council](https://www.ggbcf.org/professional-advisors/estate-planning-council): Partnership with Estate Planning Council of Northeast Wisconsin for networking
